purpose: Teach: 岩波書店/ワーキング/大学院生/読了/セーブ/日弁連/コンディション/クラッシュ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、岩波書店の経営書を読まれた
lines.en: When Dad founded the company, he read business books — Iwanami especially.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Opens with quiet warmth, settling into memory. Soft index-finger weight on key details. Unhurried, as if checking if the listener knows this already.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはワーキングタイム制度を導入された
lines.en: Yes. He introduced the working-time system.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Simple syllables, no ornament. The tone of someone nodding slowly in recognition. Brief, because the weight is in the memory, not the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、大学院生からの直接採用もされた
lines.en: He even hired directly from graduate programs.
lines.style: Quieter now. The 'even' carries gentle surprise — at how far-thinking he was. Slower pace. Trails off slightly, like standing in front of something you still admire.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書の読了を社員に徹底された
lines.en: Yes. He made sure every employee understood every contract they signed.
lines.style: Clear, measured. Not stern — careful. The kind of thoroughness that comes from respect, not fear. Steady eye-contact level throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、帳簿のセーブを毎日確認された
lines.en: He checked the ledgers every single day. Made sure the books balanced.
lines.style: Softer still. A kind of tender appreciation in the voice — for that daily discipline. Slight emphasis on 'every day,' but not proud, just... noticing. Fade gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは日弁連の助言で法務を整備された
lines.en: Yes. And he brought in legal counsel — the bar association recommended it — to make sure everything was sound.
lines.style: Methodical, grounded. Not lecturing. The voice of someone going through a careful list, honoring each step. Slight warmth on 'recommended,' recognizing the wisdom of seeking guidance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員のコンディションに敏感だった
lines.en: He was alert to how his staff were doing. Always watching for the small signs.
lines.style: Tender, observant. The rhythm shifts — slower, more intimate. Like describing someone's hands. A quiet note of longing in 'always.' Trail off on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはサーバークラッシュ時にも冷静だった
lines.en: Yes. When the servers crashed, he never panicked. He stayed composed.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Not boasting — witnessing. The voice lands solidly on 'composed' like he's placing a stone. A moment of stillness after. This is the final piece, and it settles like a coda.
